html: Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs. It can be caused by bacteria, viruses or fungi and ranges from mild to life-threatening.

• Cough, which may bring up mucus
  • Fever and chills
  • Shortness of breath
  • Chest pain when breathing or coughing
  • Confusion in older adults

• Adults 65 and older and young children
  • People with chronic heart or lung conditions
  • People who smoke or have weakened immune systems
Vaccines can help prevent some types of pneumonia. Ask your care team which vaccines are right for you.
Seek care for trouble breathing, chest pain, a persistent fever, or a cough with pus.
